The '''2002–03 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 67th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league in Greece. The season began on 24 August 2002 and ended on 25 May 2003. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their seventh consecutive and 32nd Greek title. Olympiacos and [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]] finished the League with the same points total but Olympiacos were crowned champions due to more favourable results between the two teams. It was a very dramatic end to the season, with the decisive game between the two clubs taking place in the penultimate round. The season was interrupted by strike action after television broadcaster Alpha Digital collapsed in September 2002, following which the players didn't play for a month.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/news-media/news/018e-0f84488f4ae0-cdcca3476847-1000--greek-football-at-the-crossroads/|title=Greek football at the crossroads|work=UEFA|date=7 February 2003|access-date=12 May 2013}}</ref>
